verdict.rationale: Deel's own materials address one part of the story: a guarantee to refund 100% of fees if USCIS denies the application. That covers the financial consequence of a denial, but not next steps such as re-filing or appeals. Canada appears only as a supported digital nomad visa destination, not as an interim fallback, and nothing covers running the company remotely while waiting. Missing for 10: guidance on operating the company remotely during processing, Canadian or other interim visa options framed as fallbacks, post-denial legal next steps beyond the fee refund, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's materials honestly cover the fallbacks — running the company remotely while waiting, Canadian or other interim options, and what happens after a denial

citations.quote: we back it with a guarantee: if USCIS denies your application, we refund 100% of our fees.
